recap.text: Crawler Elle McGibbons opens the Gate of the Feral Gods, letting Meatus and Harpocrates into a warzone. Harpocrates fights Meatus immediately. Harpocrates marks Princess Donut for death, but Li Jun puts himself between the god and the cat. Li Na conscripts Harpocrates with paperwork. Carl picks up a Pied Piper benefit off Harpocrates, which Eris makes permanent.

beats.headline: Second through the gate
beats.text: Crawler Elle McGibbons opens the Gate of the Feral Gods in Dream territory, which is a thing one does when the alternative is worse. Meatus comes through first. Harpocrates arrives straight after him, because a feral god loose from the Nothing summons a deity of its own. You get what you asked for, and then you get what it brought. Two deities are now loose in a warzone that already has more armies in it than it has room for.
beats.gist: Elle McGibbons opens the Gate of the Feral Gods, letting Meatus and Harpocrates enter a warzone.

beats.headline: The two of them go for each other
beats.text: Update on the two gods in the Dream territory: they are fighting each other. Not the crawlers, not the armies, each other, immediately and with feeling. Whatever the crawlers were hoping for when that gate opened, this is a better result than any of them had a right to. Elsewhere the dwarves set off a volcano in Reaver territory, because everyone on this floor has decided that scale is a substitute for a plan.
beats.gist: Harpocrates and another god fight each other in the Dream territory while dwarves set off a volcano.

beats.headline: He marks the princess
beats.text: Harpocrates marks Crawler Princess Donut for death. Crawler Li Jun puts himself between the god and the cat, and does not walk away from it. Note for the record that a mark from a deity is not a threat, it is a scheduling entry, and this one now has a name in the margin that was not there this morning.
beats.gist: Harpocrates marks Princess Donut for death, but Li Jun puts himself between the god and the cat.

beats.headline: Conscripted
beats.text: Crawler Li Na conscripts Harpocrates. A god of silence, level 250, invulnerable on this floor, is now on a crawler's side of the board because a crawler had the paperwork to put him there. Two chapters of him rampaging across the territory, and the resolution is administrative. I would like it noted that I find this floor exhausting.
beats.gist: Crawler Li Na conscripts Harpocrates, a level 250 god of silence who is invulnerable on this floor.

beats.headline: A Pied Piper benefit, made permanent
beats.text: Crawler Carl picked up a Pied Piper benefit off Harpocrates, the way a crawler picks up a temporary thing off any deity who wanders too close. Eris makes it permanent. She also tells him where the gate is, that Britney has picked an axe up off the ground and is now possessed, and, without explanation, that he is married. One of those three items is the reason he stops listening to the other two.
beats.gist: Carl picks up a Pied Piper benefit from Harpocrates, which Eris makes permanent.
